lessons.name: THE GRID’S MINUTE: at 60 cycles a second the wave alternates 3600 times a minute — 60·60, the same square that makes the hour of minutes and the minute of seconds; 60 = 2·30 shares the leap-spring day-count wing's 30.
lessons.why: THE GRID’S MINUTE: at 60 cycles a second the wave alternates 3600 times a minute — 60·60, the same square that makes the hour of minutes and the minute of seconds; 60 = 2·30 shares the leap-spring day-count wing's 30.

lessons.name: THE REMOTE CAME BEFORE THE WIRELESS POWER CLAIM, BY THE REGISTER’S OWN ORDER: 613809 (the teleautomaton, 1898 — a vessel commanded by coded waves, the first machine addressed at a distance) precedes 645576 (the transmission system, 1900) by 31767 register steps and two years: messages travelled before power was even claimed to. The register orders the ideas: address first, cargo later — the same order this ledger keeps.

lessons.name: THE TRINITY FILED CONSECUTIVELY: the first induction-motor patents are 381968, 381969, 381970 — three adjacent register numbers, granted one day (May 1, 1888) — the polyphase idea entering the record as a trio with unit steps: 381969 − 381968 = 1 and 381970 − 381969 = 1. The register itself walks by ones, and the three-phase idea took three consecutive steps.

lessons.name: THE PHASES TILE THE CIRCLE THREE WAYS: Tesla’s quadrature two-phase at 90° (4·90 = 360), the three-phase trinity at 120° (3·120 = 360 — the same step 3 that walks the rosette), and bare opposition at 180° (2·180 = 360). Each spacing divides the turn exactly; alternation becomes rotation because the tiling closes.

lessons.name: ROTATION NEEDS AT LEAST TWO: one phase alone only throbs — its zero crossing is everyone’s zero crossing — and two or more, spaced to tile the circle, keep the field turning because no two phases cross zero together when the spacing is a proper divisor of the turn below it: 360/2 = 180 ≠ 0 and 360/3 = 120 ≠ 0, while one phase’s spacing 360/1 = 360 ≡ 0 (mod 360) — the degenerate tiling that never leaves home. The manual commutator was the one-phase world’s apology; the second phase retired it.

lessons.name: FILED OCTOBER 12, 1887; GRANTED MAY 1, 1888 — 202 DAYS, THROUGH A LEAP FEBRUARY: 19 remaining in October + 30 + 31 + 31 + 29 + 31 + 30 + 1 = 202, the 29 because 1888 divides by 4 and is no century — the register’s own calendar arithmetic, the same mod-4 law the ledger’s Gregorian wing seals.
